summary.text: Fairy Feng Ya is one of three Heavenly Court female immortals of pseudo venerable battle strength in Crazed Demon Cave, stronger than Ming Hao and Yu Xiu, and the one whose labor produced Book Mountain.

claims.text: Bing Sai Chuan names Ming Hao, Yu Xiu, and Feng Ya as three Heavenly Court female immortals of pseudo venerable battle strength who cultivate wisdom path with star path secondarily. He says Fairy Feng Ya seems even stronger than Fairy Yu Xiu but has never taken action, staying secluded in Crazed Demon Cave to comprehend the ninth layer profundity, and that Book Mountain is the fruit of her labor.

Heaven envies heroic geniuses reaches Book Mountain and targets Fairy Feng Ya. She possesses talent Gu and is in closed cultivation to deduce Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangement. Wisdom path deductions expose her, so heaven and earth start a tribulation to exterminate her. Qin Ding Ling wants to send Divine Emperor City after Fang Yuan. Fairy Yu Xiu refuses and says the key is to protect Fairy Feng Ya and resist the tribulation so she can keep deducting.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun says Heavenly Court’s Feng Ya has been trying to deduce Limitless Demon Venerable’s arrangements while obstructed by Thieving Heaven’s space. After that space is destroyed, he expects her progress to become smooth. He also says that when he deduced Limitless’ arrangements he fought her from afar, that she is the strongest wisdom path expert among the three pseudo venerables, and that she has already come into contact with Primordial Domain, the other core of the ninth layer.

At the peak of Book Mountain, Fairy Feng Ya takes the main seat above Fairy Yu Xiu, Fairy Ming Hao, Qin Ding Ling, and Che Wei. Her hair is tied up in a bun. She is old but not wrinkled, and she retains her beauty and elegance. Her entire body is covered in a thin layer of dazzling light, the sign that she possesses talent Gu. She forces Primordial Domain to appear. After Thieving Heaven’s space falls, Yu Xiu and Ming Hao teleport back to her side with their troops. She orders Heavenly Court to stay on defense at Book Mountain and endure Giant Sun and Fang Yuan’s attacks.
She keeps using her killer move without stopping at the peak, drawing out Primordial Domain in the sky, while Ming Hao and Yu Xiu take charge of the wider fight.
She must keep using her full strength on the killer move to obtain Primordial Domain and cannot be interrupted, while Ming Hao and Yu Xiu send living substitutes down for Immortal Gu Houses.
When Zhan Bu Du nears the peak, she has to multitask and control Star Constellation Chessboard while still retrieving Primordial Domain, which greatly reduces her efficiency.

In Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s earlier life, after her senior sister offers to assimilate with heaven’s will, Star Constellation takes starlight from her heart and names one starlight shadow Feng Ya, saying her senior sister praised her for great magnanimity, and leaves Feng Ya to accompany that senior sister. She also says the three starlight shadows are arrangements for revival. When Ming Hao, Yu Xiu, and Feng Ya wake in Crazed Demon Cave, they receive news that Fate Gu is destroyed and Heavenly Court has fallen into crisis. Fairy Feng Ya looks at the charging Zhan Bu Du and smiles plainly as starlight resonates on the three fairies.

On Book Mountain the three star avatars join into one and turn into Star Constellation Immortal Venerable. Fang Yuan had already speculated that Ming Hao, Yu Xiu, and Feng Ya were her avatars. Inside the revived venerable’s immortal aperture, Fairy Feng Ya’s talent Gu activates with Fairy Yu Xiu’s serious Gu and learning Gu from Divine Emperor City as she escapes golden light and enters Primordial Domain.
